summary.short: Enforcement decree of South Korea's AI Basic Act. Sets the carve-out for defence and intelligence AI, criteria for high-impact and computing-scale AI systems, labelling and notice duties for AI business operators, impact assessments, record-keeping, support programmes and domestic-agent criteria. In force from 22 January 2026.
summary.long: Presidential Decree No. 36053 (enacted 21 January 2026, in force 22 January 2026; digital medical device parts from 24 January 2026) implements the AI Basic Act. It excludes AI used solely for listed defence, intelligence and security tasks designated by the Defence Minister, the National Intelligence Service director or the Police Commissioner. It sets up the National AI Strategy Committee, its support secretariat, AI policy centres, the AI Safety Research Institute and an AI industry association. For AI business operators it requires notice to users when a product or service is based on high-impact or generative AI, with labelling of generated output in human- or machine-readable form, and exemptions for obvious use or internal use. It defines a computing-scale test for AI safety duties (cumulative training compute of 10^26 floating-point operations, plus state-of-the-art technology and broad serious-risk criteria). It sets a procedure for the Ministry to confirm whether a system is high-impact, with 30-day response periods. Operators must publish risk-management information, keep records for five years and carry out impact assessments. Large operators must appoint a domestic agent under revenue, user-number and fine-history criteria. Fines follow a standards table in an annex not reproduced in this text. The decree also covers support for learning data, a data integration system, AI industrial clusters and sandbox infrastructure.</parameter>

notes: Relations are taken only from this decree's text; target registry IDs are not known, so target_instrument_id is empty. The Act is named in 제1조 and identified by act number (법률 제20676호) only in 부칙 제3조. Annexes 별표 1 and 별표 2 and the 별지서식 forms appear only as titles and .hwp placeholders; their content is not in the document, and 제27조제5항 and 제32조 depend on it. 부칙 제1조 sets a 2026-01-24 start for the digital medical device part of 별표 1, which cannot be checked here. Cited statute articles in 제2조 exclusions were not verified against those statutes. No internal numerical or cross-reference inconsistency was found.

thresholds.variable_text: 누적 연산량 (cumulative computation used for training)
thresholds.measurement: Cumulative computation used to train the AI system; calculation method set by 과학기술정보통신부장관 notice (제24조제2항).
thresholds.consequence: Defines the high-capability AI system subject to the safety obligations of 법 제32조 (AI system meeting the 대통령령 criteria).
thresholds.conditions: All three criteria in 제24조제1항 must be met jointly: (1) this compute threshold; (2) state-of-the-art AI technology in use; (3) risk of broad and serious impact on human life, bodily safety and fundamental rights.

evidence.quote: 학습에 사용된 누적 연산량이 10의 26승 부동소수점연산 이상일 것

thresholds.variable_text: 전년도 매출액 (prior-year sales revenue of the AI business operator)
thresholds.measurement: Prior fiscal year (for corporations, prior business year) sales; converted to won at the prior-year average exchange rate (제29조제2항).
thresholds.consequence: Operator falls within the 대통령령 criteria for AI business operators subject to the domestic agent requirement of 법 제36조제1항.
thresholds.conditions: Alternative criteria in 제29조제1항: AI service segment sales of 100억원 or more; or 1 million or more average daily domestic users; or a prior fine under 법 제43조제1항제3호. Any one suffices.

evidence.quote: 전년도(법인인 경우에는 전 사업연도를 말한다) 매출액이 1조원 이상인 인공지능사업자

thresholds.variable_text: 인공지능서비스 부문 전년도 매출액 (prior-year sales of the AI service segment)
thresholds.measurement: Prior fiscal year (for corporations, prior business year) sales of the AI service segment; converted to won at the prior-year average exchange rate (제29조제2항).
thresholds.consequence: Operator falls within the 대통령령 criteria for AI business operators subject to the domestic agent requirement of 법 제36조제1항.
thresholds.conditions: Alternative criteria in 제29조제1항: total prior-year sales of 1조원 or more; or 1 million or more average daily domestic users; or a prior fine under 법 제43조제1항제3호. Any one suffices.

evidence.quote: 인공지능서비스 부문 전년도(법인인 경우에는 전 사업연도를 말한다) 매출액이 100억원 이상인 인공지능사업자

thresholds.variable_text: 국내 이용자 수 (average daily domestic users of AI products and services over the prior 3 months)
thresholds.measurement: Average daily number of domestic users over the 3 months immediately preceding the end of the prior year, for the operator's AI products and AI services.
thresholds.consequence: Operator falls within the 대통령령 criteria for AI business operators subject to the domestic agent requirement of 법 제36조제1항.
thresholds.conditions: Alternative criteria in 제29조제1항: total prior-year sales of 1조원 or more; AI service segment sales of 100억원 or more; or a prior fine under 법 제43조제1항제3호. Any one suffices.

evidence.quote: 전년도 말 기준 해당 인공지능사업자의 인공지능제품 및 인공지능서비스에 대한 직전 3개월간 국내 이용자 수가 1일 평균 100만명 이상인 인공지능사업자

thresholds.variable_text: 전담인력 (full-time dedicated staff for supporting an AI industrial complex)
thresholds.measurement: Number of dedicated staff permanently employed to support the AI industrial complex.
thresholds.consequence: Staffing requirement that an organisation must meet to be designated as the dedicated agency (전담기관) of an AI industrial complex under 제18조제1항.
thresholds.conditions: All requirements in 제18조제1항 must be met jointly: type of organisation, staffing, location, office and meeting rooms, and accounting and personnel information system.

evidence.quote: 인공지능집적단지의 지원을 위한 전담인력을 5명 이상 상시 고용할 것

thresholds.variable_text: 발기인 수 (founders engaged in AI-related research or work)
thresholds.measurement: Number of founders who are persons engaged in research or work related to AI, as stated in 제20조제1항.
thresholds.consequence: Founder requirement for filing an application with 과학기술정보통신부장관 to establish 한국인공지능진흥협회 (인가).
thresholds.conditions: Founders must act through a 발기인총회 resolution after drafting articles of association; application documents listed in 제20조제2항 must be attached.
